the mean velocity of particles emitted from a polycristalline copper surface decreases rapidly above 200 keV with increasing ion energy and reaches a nearly constant value at about E = 800 keV.

the mean velocity of particles sputtered from a polycyrsalline Cu surface decreases with increasing ion energy above about 150 keV.
